title: Decision Criteria Worksheet version 1.0
decision: Choose a suitable venue for a three-hour community workshop.

constraints.requirement: Legally permitted capacity of at least 40 people
Step-free route to the workshop room

criteria.Definition: All required venue charges for the same three-hour booking, including mandatory equipment, fees and applicable taxes; exclude unrequested optional extras
criteria.Unit or rating rule: State one currency before collecting amounts
criteria.Evidence needed: Opened itemised quotation for the same booking

criteria.Why it matters: Know the duration of the journey
criteria.Definition: Typical one-way journey from Central Library entrance using the same transport mode and comparable departure period
criteria.Unit or rating rule: Minutes; record the chosen mode and period
criteria.Evidence needed: Opened current journey information, origin and method recorded

criteria.Why it matters: Support attendees beyond the required route
criteria.Definition: Confirmed relevant features beyond the step-free route to the workshop room: hearing support, accessible toilet, suitable seating space and access to all required areas
criteria.Unit or rating rule: Record each confirmed feature separately; do not score the word accessible
criteria.Evidence needed: Opened feature details or explicit venue confirmation

criteria.Definition: Confirmed seating layout, presentation space and activity space
criteria.Unit or rating rule: Before assessment, agree explicit requirements for seating layout, presentation space and planned activity space. Meets: all three requirements confirmed met. Partly meets: one or two confirmed met and the others confirmed not met. Does not meet: all three confirmed not met. Unknown: any requirement or its evidence is missing. Never override a failed pass-or-stop constraint.
criteria.Evidence needed: Opened layout information and activity requirements

criteria.Unit or rating rule: Record deadline, fee, refund condition and exceptions separately

criteria.Definition: Service frequency and final walking route during the agreed arrival period
criteria.Unit or rating rule: Frequency and route details; keep separate from travel duration

sharedBasis.currency: Not specified; choose one before collecting costs
sharedBasis.plannedActivities: Agree and record before evaluating layout

evidenceStatus: No venue evidence supplied; no venue has passed screening, been ranked or selected.
